# Corruption minigame (generated by tools/romania_focus_gen/corruption.py).
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ROM }
				ROM = { ROM_corruption_init = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = ROM }
				ROM_corruption_weekly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
